title: The vote was close, though
pt: Foco da aula: conectores de contraste: though / even so / however

solo90.name: Pausa

lines.en: Sofia, the result is out. We won the vote, although only by a small margin. It was close, though.
lines.pt: Sofia, o resultado saiu. Ganhamos a votação, embora por pouca margem. Foi apertada, porém.

lines.en: I saw it. Despite all our efforts, nearly half of the members voted against the proposal. Even so, a win is a win.
lines.pt: Eu vi. Apesar de todo o nosso esforço, quase metade dos membros votou contra a proposta. Mesmo assim, vitória é vitória.

lines.en: True. However, we shouldn’t celebrate too early. The other side is angry, and some of them may appeal.
lines.pt: Verdade. No entanto, não devemos comemorar cedo demais. O outro lado está irritado, e alguns podem recorrer.

lines.en: They’re entitled to, although I doubt it will change anything. The rules were followed carefully, though.
lines.pt: Eles têm direito, embora eu duvide que mude algo. As regras foram seguidas com cuidado, porém.

lines.en: Even so, we should listen to them. In spite of the result, their concerns about costs are reasonable.
lines.pt: Mesmo assim, devemos ouvi-los. Apesar do resultado, as preocupações deles com custos são razoáveis.

lines.en: You’re right. The budget is tight; on the other hand, the project could attract many visitors to Liverpool.
lines.pt: Você tem razão. O orçamento é apertado; por outro lado, o projeto poderia atrair muitos visitantes a Liverpool.

lines.en: Exactly. It may cost a lot at first. In the long run, however, it should pay for itself.
lines.pt: Exato. Pode custar muito no início. A longo prazo, porém, deve se pagar sozinho.

lines.en: Although I supported the plan, I’m still worried about the timetable. It’s very ambitious, even so.
lines.pt: Embora eu tenha apoiado o plano, ainda me preocupo com o cronograma. Ele é muito ambicioso, mesmo assim.

lines.en: Fair point. Whereas the first phase is simple, the second one needs more people, which is a risk.
lines.pt: Bom ponto. Enquanto a primeira fase é simples, a segunda precisa de mais gente, o que é um risco.

lines.en: Then let’s propose a meeting with the opposition. Despite our differences, we could find a middle ground.
lines.pt: Então vamos propor uma reunião com a oposição. Apesar das diferenças, podemos achar um meio-termo.

lines.en: Good idea. I’ll write to them today. They may refuse; however, it costs nothing to try.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. Escreverei a eles hoje. Podem recusar; no entanto, tentar não custa nada.

facts.label: Conectores de contraste
facts.sub: Although it was close, we won. Despite the result, they are angry. However, we shouldn’t celebrate. It was close, though.

facts.label: embora
facts.sub: Although liga duas orações: Although it was close, we won. Though é informal e pode ir no fim: It was close, though. Even though dá mais ênfase. Depois de although vem sujeito e verbo.

facts.label: apesar de
facts.sub: Despite e in spite of precisam de substantivo ou -ing: Despite the result; In spite of being tired. Nunca despite of. Se tiver oração completa, use although.

items.s: Although is followed by a clause.

items.why: Despite is followed by a noun or -ing.

Despite is followed by a clause with subject and verb. → Falso (Despite is followed by a noun or -ing.)

pages.title: A close vote · 1/3
paragraphs: Esme and Tom work at a community centre in Liverpool. They are in the meeting room after an important vote. The members had to choose a new project for the building. The result was very close. Some people are happy, but others are not. Esme and Tom discuss what to do next.

“Tom, the result is out. We won the vote, although only by a small margin. It was close, though.” says Esme. “I saw it. Despite all our efforts, nearly half of the members voted against the proposal. Even so, a win is a win.” says Tom. “True. However, we shouldn’t celebrate too early. The other side is angry, and some of them may appeal.” says Esme.
